in_sanskrit.name: अनिकेत्राज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अनिक (Anik) - Unique, केत (Ket) - Lord, राज (Raj) - Ruler. The name Aniketraj means 'Lord of the Unique' in Sanskrit.

in_hindi.name: अनिकेतराज
in_hindi.meaning: सिद्ध अनिक (Aniket) - Famous Anik, राज (Raj) - Ruler. The name Aniketraj in Hindi can be interpreted as 'Famous Anik, Ruler'.

in_tamil.name: அனிகேற்றாஜ்
in_tamil.meaning: அனிக (Anik) - Unique, இற்றா (Ittara) - Possessor, அஜ் (Aj) - Lord. The name Aniketraj in Tamil can be interpreted as 'Lord of the Unique Possession'.

in_telugu.name: అనికేట్రాజ్
in_telugu.meaning: అనిక (Anik) - Unique, ఎట్ (Et) - Lord, రాజ్ (Raj) - Ruler. The name Aniketraj in Telugu can be interpreted as 'Lord of the Unique'.

in_marathi.name: Aniketraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aniketraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ani- (not) + Ketu (shadow) + Raaj (king) - The one who is not under the shadow of Lord Ketu. A reference to Lord Vishnu.

in_bengali.name: Aniketraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Majestic Lord
in_bengali.long_meaning: Aniketraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ani- (not) + Ketu (shadow) + Raaj (king) - The one who is not under the shadow of Lord Ketu. A reference to Lord Vishnu.
